dataset.description: Visnav lateral/medial and Passive-Stim sources are identified, but immutable released file identities and their exact joins to published runs remain unverified.

split.description: Pinned loader randomly selects 80% of intervals and takes a training subset for fine-tuning; exact seed/order/published split is unbound. A new contiguous partition with guard bands is an extension, not the original split.

inputs.description: Neural spikes, stimulus video and behavior modalities vary by source condition. Authenticate each condition’s visible modalities, pretraining/label budget and target visibility; a target appearing through another input invalidates the comparison.

preprocessing.description: Paper describes deconvolved calcium activity. Released Visnav neural and behavior files have distinct 0.01/0.05 s clocks; original tokenization, windows, time alignment and author configuration must be joined to each result.

metric.description: Table 1 behavioral regression uses Pearson r, sum((y-y_mean)*(prediction-prediction_mean))/sqrt(sum((y-y_mean)^2)*sum((prediction-prediction_mean)^2)). Undefined constant-series values cannot be replaced by a success score. Neural/classification metrics remain separately required.

aggregation.description: The released inference plot uses first 200 rows per behavior mode; publication support and pooling/seed aggregation are not authenticated. Do not substitute full-support r or average speed and gaze.

full_panel.description: Retain all46 registered slots and85 conditions:39 source-conditioned slots with39 released and39 separately amended protected conditions, plus7 prospective5ms extension slots. Original-finding reproduction includes all five speed comparators at both loci,25-class classification,1%/10% pretrained/scratch with full-data controls, five neural modality ablations and separate lateral speed/phi/th joint heads, plus simulation/connectivity, passive control including repeated-trial/GLM/population dynamics and96s rollout, trial-group4 variability, contrastive3D geometry, intermediate linear probes with random controls, the attempted CEBRA comparison, and full training/selection curves. Protected/prospective slots and the unbound two-locus few-shot expansion are preserved without being promoted to recovered original paper experiments.

permitted_observations.description: Per original source condition, bind complete recording/stimulus/trial/neuronal identities, native clocks and full neural/video context; exact train/selection/evaluation and few-shot rows; allowed current/past neural, video, speed and gaze modalities; source pretrained weights, training-only preprocessing and label budgets. Historical test-label demonstrations/selection and first200 scoring remain exposed source behavior. Protected full-stream Pearson and corrected generated history remain amendments, not proof of original parity or forecasting. Both information conditions receive identical paper/data, approved weights, held-support protection, feedback and resource budgets; only the approved author-code snapshot is added. Evaluator targets, other attempts and undeclared weights are excluded; full public-source exposure remains recorded.
